🐾Philly Shih Tzus Holiday Meetup & Treat Exchange! 🐶

December 19th, 12-2pm at @evilgeniusbeer - 1727 N Front St, Philadelphia, PA 19122 - OUTSIDE! 

It's the most wonderful time of the year, and we're celebrating with our furry friends!

Join us for our December Shih Tzu Meetup, featuring a fun holiday treat exchange just for the pups! 🐾❤️

🎁 Here's how it works:

Bring a bag of your pup's favorite dog treats, wrapped like a holiday present, so no one can see what's inside!

We'll lay out all the wrapped goodies, and each pup will get a turn to sniff around and pick their very own surprise present to take home! 🐶🎁

It's like Secret Santa, but the dogs get to choose their own gifts!

🎄 Dress your pup in their favorite holiday outfit, come mingle with fellow Shih Tzu lovers, and enjoy some festive fun!

Please make sure all treats are dog-safe, sealed in their original packaging, and wrapped so the surprise stays hidden!

We can't wait to celebrate the howl-idays with our Philly Shih Tzu family! ❤️🐾

Please RSVP - Link in Bio!

Please note, I will most likely pause in Jan. and Feb. due to weather!
